# NumDetect Bulk Global Carrier Lookup
> Official examples for the NumDetect bulk product `global_carrier_batch`.

## Canonical resources
- [Product page](https://numdetect.com/products/global_carrier_batch): Turn a phone list into routing-ready context. Append carrier, underlying carrier, line type, country, region and city to international records, then use the enriched result for routing, regional analysis, segmentation and CRM updates.
- [API documentation](https://numdetect.com/api-docs): Canonical request, response, limit, and error contract.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/numdetect/phone-bulk-carrier-api): Official multi-language examples and OpenAPI contract.
- [Registration](https://numdetect.com/register): Account registration and API-key access.
- [Pricing](https://numdetect.com/pricing): Current product pricing.

## Product facts
- Brand: NumDetect.
- Product code: global_carrier_batch.
- Mode: asynchronous bulk task.
- API base URL: https://numdetect.com.
- Authentication: X-API-Key request header.
- Submit: POST /api/v1/bulk-tasks with product=global_carrier_batch, country and a file field.
- Poll: GET /api/v1/bulk-tasks/{id}; status is processing, success or failed.
- Poll interval: no more than once every 30 seconds.
- Task size: 500 to 100000 entries, .txt or .csv, one phone number per line.
- Input kind: phone.
- Country: required, one country per task.
- Result columns: number, carrier, underlying_carrier, number_type, country_code, region, city.
- Billing: the file is reserved on submit; only checked entries are charged and the rest is returned. Failed tasks are refunded.
- Examples: Python, Node.js, Go, Java, C#, PHP, Shell.
